Preserve character identity from attached sheets, but never copy the sheet layout. The LAST reference is the shared clean environment: preserve geography/materials, change crop and camera according to this shot. Shared scene geography, binding across the whole sequence: the same mountain path with forked pine, low rounded boulder and rocky bank from the clean stage reference. Travel follows the path from lower left toward upper right distance. In stopped two-shots SON Geom Mugeuk is on the LEFT, FATHER Geom Ujin on the RIGHT. Father faces left toward son; son faces right toward father. Keep camera on the valley/near side of the relationship axis; camera may move between side, three-quarter front and rear within that side, but do not mirror their world positions. Father has no backpack; son wears the SAME large hunting backpack throughout. When father turns partly to leave then asks another question, their feet remain on the same stopping patch. Finger attack is father's anatomical RIGHT index finger; it passes immediately beside son's anatomical RIGHT cheek, never through skin. Son turns his face away from the air line, cheek stays uninjured. Father lowers attacking hand by his reaction shot. Son touches that same RIGHT cheek with his RIGHT hand through protest and joke. He lowers the hand before following father. At the ending father leads along the same path, son follows several steps behind. Father never turns back during praise or thanks. Son looks ALONG the path toward father, not backward toward camera. Maintain soft daylight, clothing, ages, backpack and landmarks. No new people, weapon use, wounds or extra attacks. The faint air streak appears ONLY in the attack frame, nowhere else.
